name: Evergreen Payments Northwest Gateway For WooCommerce
author: Evergreen Payments Northwest LLC

sections.description:
Evergreen Payments Northwest is the perfect solution for Hemp and high risk e-commerce.

WooCommerce is one of the oldest and most powerful e-commerce solutions for WordPress. This platform is very widely supported in the WordPress community which makes it easy for even an entry level e-commerce entrepreneur to learn to use and modify.

Features

  • Easy Install: One click installation to WooCommerce. Then enter gateway specific user and security information and start accepting payments!
  • Secure Credit Card Processing: Securely send payment data to your Evergreen Payments Northwest Transaction Gateway. Adhere to the highest level of security certification and PCI standards.
  • Process Subscriptions: Use with WooCommerce Subscriptions extension to create and manage products with recurring payments — payments that will give you residual revenue you can track and count on.
  • Setup Pre-Orders: Use with WooCommerce Pre-Orders extension so customers can order products before they’re available by submitting their card details. The card is then automatically charged when the pre-order is available.
  • 3D Secure 2 Card Verification: Optionally, enable 3D Secure 2 card verification and make your site Strong Customer Authentication (SCA) compliant.
  • Pay via Saved Cards: Enable option to use saved card details on the gateway servers for quicker checkout. No sensitive card data is stored on the website!
  • Refund via Dashboard: Process full or partial refunds, directly from your WordPress dashboard! No need to search order in your Evergreen Payments Northwest account.
  • Authorize Now, Capture Later: Optionally choose only to authorize transactions, and capture at a later date.
  • Restrict Card Types: Optionally choose to restrict certain card types and the plugin will hide its icon and provide a proper error message on checkout.
  • Gateway Receipts: Optionally choose to send receipts from your Evergreen Payments Northwest merchant account.
  • Logging: Enable logging, so you can debug issues that arise if any.

Requirements

  • Active Evergreen Payments Northwest Merchant and Payment Gateway Accounts.
  • WooCommerce version 3.3.0 or later.
  • A valid SSL certificate is required to ensure your customer credit card details are safe and make your site PCI DSS compliant. This plugin does not store the customer credit card numbers or sensitive information on your website.
    Visit the plugin page for more details.

External services

Evergreen Payments Northwest uses NMI as their gateway solutions provider and processes API requests through their exclusive domain https://evergreenpayments.transactiongateway.com domain. Check the NMI merchant terms and conditions and privacy policy for more details on how your data is handled.
sections.installation:
Easy steps to install the plugin:

  1. Upload evergreen-payments-northwest-gateway-wc folder/directory to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin (WordPress -> Plugins).
  3. Go to the WooCommerce settings page (WordPress -> WooCommerce -> Settings) and select the Payments tab.
  4. Under the Payments tab, you will find all the available payment methods. Find the ‘Evergreen Payments Northwest’ link in the list and click it.
  5. On this page you will find all the configuration options for this payment gateway.
  6. Enable the method by using the checkbox.
  7. Enter the Evergreen Payments Northwest API keys (Private Key and Public Tokenization Key).

That’s it! You are ready to accept credit cards with your Evergreen Payments Northwest gateway now connected to WooCommerce.
sections.faq:
Is SSL Required to use this plugin?

A valid SSL certificate is required to ensure your customer credit card details are safe and make your site PCI DSS compliant. This plugin does not store the customer credit card numbers or sensitive information on your website.
sections.changelog:
1.1.0

  • Added “Capture authorized transaction on status change” option
  • Added filter for capturing on order status change
  • Added card validation error to order notes when collect.js is disabled
  • Added Dynamic Descriptor option
  • Added needs_payment flag for renewal payments
  • Added backward compatibility for refunds
  • Mentioned authorized and captured amounts in order note
  • Fixed card details not showing on HPOS sites
  • Fixed issue with 3DS payment processing
  • Fixed issues with WC version < 8.4.0
  • Fixed gateway log URL
  • Made compatible with Avada multi step checkout and Theme high multi step checkout
  • Set order status to Failed only once on unsuccessful capture from Edit Order screen
  • Prevent blocking the billing details area for distraction free checkout
  • Saved card last4 and card type to order meta
  • Removed customer ID usage in order and subscription meta
  • Removed jquery-payment script handle
  • Ignored passing customer_vault_id if the payment is not from a saved card
  • Updated “WC tested up to” header to 10.3

1.0.1

  • Made plugin WordPress.org ready

1.0.0

  • Initial release version
